description: Publishes the latest saved version of a draft press release on LivePublicator, including changes the user made on the draft page, and tells search engines about it. Only call this after the user has seen the preview and clearly said to publish, and set confirm to true. Uses 1 credit. Returns the live link within seconds, or says the release is waiting for a person to check it, with the reason and the expected time (up to 24 hours). If LivePublicator does not publish it, the credit comes back.

confirm.description: true: the user saw the preview and said to publish.

name: publish_release
title: Publish a release
